g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to create a Windows recovery drive: Preparing a
blank USB and backing up personal files
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-08
Prepare a blank USB
Creating a recovery drive erases all content on
the selected USB.
Create it with the system file backup
option
Search for Recovery Drive in the Start menu and
open it, or enter recoverydrive.exe in the Run
window.
Back up personal files separately from
the recovery drive
Microsoft explains that personal files are not
included on a recovery drive and recommends
using another method, such as File History or…
Check which option to choose when
starting with the recovery USB
The method for starting a PC from USB differs by
manufacturer, so check the manufacturer's
documentation first.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
